reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

The answer comes from that same incident channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 3 Sep 2025, Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Later that day she posted that Southgate had cleared the backlog.

The channel doesn't give an address or any other site details for Southgate, so I told him that and suggested he ask Priyanka for the full site details.
